newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Music shares higher after stock rating raised.
newsitem.headline: Sony Music shares higher after stock rating raised.

text.p: Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc shares rose on Wednesday morning, lifted by an upward revision of its rating by a "big four" brokerage, brokers said.
As of 0122 GMT, the shares were 210 yen higher at 4,350 yen, making it the fourth largest percentage gainer on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Market sources said earlier on Wednesday that Nomura Research Institute Ltd had upgraded the firm to a "1" from its previous "2".

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "1" rating to issues whose values it expects will outperform the key 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
Nomura officials were not immediately available for comment.
